mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_period_close (id, period_id, close_no, close_type, reopens_close_id, reopen_reason_code, reopen_request_ref, status, active_slot, maker_id, checker_id, close_hash, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{id}, #{periodId}, #{closeNo}, #{closeType}, #{reopensCloseId}, #{reopenReasonCode}, #{reopenRequestRef}, #{status}, #{activeSlot}, #{makerId}, #{checkerId}, #{closeHash}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(close_no), 0) + 1 FROM t_period_close WHERE period_id = #{periodId}

SELECT id, period_id, close_no, close_type, reopens_close_id, reopen_reason_code, reopen_request_ref, status, active_slot, maker_id, checker_id, close_hash, version, create_time, update_time FROM t_period_close WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND close_no = #{closeNo}

SELECT c.id period_close_id, c.period_id, c.close_no, c.close_type, c.status, c.maker_id, c.checker_id, c.close_hash, c.create_time, (SELECT s.step_type FROM t_close_step s WHERE s.period_close_id = c.id AND s.status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY s.step_no LIMIT 1) failed_step_type FROM t_period_close c WHERE c.period_id = #{periodId} AND c.close_no = #{closeNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_period_close WHERE period_id = #{periodId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_compensation_event WHERE execute_status IN ('INIT', 'PROCESSING', 'ERROR')
